messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Impact: multiple customers reporting failures. Pager routed to oncall-eng. AlertID: INC-202679-5xx

alex: acked. I'm on pager. seeing spike ~03:07 PDT. will grab logs and check recent deploys. tagging @sara for handoff if this continues.

alex: quick snapshot from the edge (most recent 20 lines):
```
[03:06:42] ERROR handler: downstream 502 from runtime-42 (killed?)
[03:06:43] WARN kvcache: miss spike, backlog=120
[03:06:44] ERROR runtime: OOM while allocating KV cache
[03:06:46] ERROR gateway: 502 upstream
```

alex: initial thought: either runtime OOMs or a routing flap. i'm throttling concurrent inflight on the canary route to reduce pressure. will post numbers in a min.

sara: I'm taking over from alex (handoff). alex - if you need to sleep, call it out and i'll own pager. otherwise i'll coordinate mitigation. timeline note: i joined at 03:12 PDT.

mike: FYI I rolled an autoscaler tweak around 01:45 PDT to reduce minimum replicas in low-traffic pools (change: autoscaler.min=2 -> 1). that touched the us-west-2 serving pool. I can revert if that looks correlated.

lia: customers: two paying customers (acct-17, acct-94) reported errors and timeouts; support already opened SRs. latency graphs: https://metrics.internal/redwood/v1-generate?range=1h (link) — spikes line up with 03:06-03:10.

sara: collecting hypotheses and owners (quick list):
- H1 (owner: mike): autoscaler min reduction caused pod churn during a small load spike -> transient 502s/5xx. mitigation: revert autoscaler.min and monitor canary.
- H2 (owner: kevin): new quantization flag rollout for gpt-small-quant introduced memory regression -> OOMs under certain request patterns. mitigation: toggle model quantization off for the model variant.
- H3 (owner: jen): loadbalancer/circuit-breaker config misfire (timeouts) after recent LB rule change. mitigation: temporarily increase LB idle timeout and enable stricter retry gating.

sara: Plan: execute scoped experiments in canary first, timebox each 10m. sequence: revert autoscaler.min -> if no improvement, rollback quant flag -> then LB tweaks. communicate each step.

kevin: i'm ready to toggle quant flag in the control plane. command i'll run (canary only):
```
redctl feature-flags set model-quant-gpt-small false --env canary --reason "incident 1794126789"
```
I'll wait for a green on the autoscaler revert test first (avoid simultaneous changes).

mike: starting autoscaler revert in canary now. cmd:
```
kubectl apply -f autoscaler-min-1-to-2.yaml --context=us-west-2-canary
```
I'll monitor pod churn and 5xx rate. Will report back in ~5m.

alex: note: we saw a series of OOM events in runtime logs earlier, but those might be downstream of the pod churn (crash loop -> 502s). attaching a small grep:
```
grep -i oom runtime-logs-2026-03-15| tail -n 10
[03:05:58] runtime: killed process pid=4112 signal=9 (OOM)
[03:06:01] runtime: restarted worker id=12
```

mike: autoscaler revert applied at 03:20 PDT in canary. initial telemetry: canary 5xx rate dropped from 6.2% -> 0.6% within 90s. staging/other regions stable.

sara: good signal. mike - can you promote the revert to prod as a scoped mitigation? keep steady state for 15m and then we decide permanent config. owner: mike to promote; jen to hold LB changes until we see results.

mike: promoting to prod now (rolling update across us-west-2 pools). command: `deploy-tool apply autoscaler-min-2-prod` - starting. ETA ~4m.

pm-jordan: pinging comms: notify affected customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with timeline. Suggested template drafted.

jen: I'll queue LB timeout increase as a fallback but holding off per sara. reducing concurrency on the gateway as temporary mitigation: `gatewayctl set concurrency 8 --target /v1/generate` (will do if 5xx persists).

kevin: on quant toggle: standing down for now, will only run if revert doesn't fix.

mike: prod promote finished at 03:27 PDT. global 5xx back down to baseline (~0.2%).

alex: confirming customer SRs see improvements (lia: please confirm).

lia: confirmed with acct-17 and acct-94 that errors dropped after 03:30. both still receiving degraded latency but no errors. ticket updates sent.

sara: conclusion for in-incident: primary hypothesis H1 (autoscaler min reduction -> pod churn -> transient 5xx) is supported by canary & prod revert results. H2/H3 remain plausible but deprioritized.

sara: next steps (owners/ops):
- mike: open an RCA ticket and include timeline + config diff (autoscaler change) (owner: mike).
- kevin: schedule a canary for quant-flag with broader load tests, don't promote until RCA closed.
- jen: stand down LB changes. keep a rollback playbook ready.
- alex: draft incident timeline fragment with logs and attach to RCA.
- pm-jordan: coordinate customer postmortem note and follow-up comms.

alex: quick timeline snippet for RCA (timestamps PDT):
- 01:45 - mike applied autoscaler.min=1 tweak
- 03:05 - alert: 5xx spike begins
- 03:07 - incident-bot pager -> alex
- 03:12 - sara takes handoff
- 03:20 - canary autoscaler revert applied
- 03:27 - prod autoscaler revert promoted
- 03:30 - customer errors reduced

sara: assigning action owners in the RCA doc. i'll start the postmortem doc and invite the cross-functional team. i'll also schedule a 30m follow-up to validate root cause and permanent remediation (tommorrow 10:00 PDT).

pm-jordan: will send customer-facing note after sara + mike confirm wording.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT: mitigated - 5xx rate returned to baseline. Monitoring in watch window for 1h. Alert suppressed.

sara: closing thread for live mitigation. please post any additional forensic logs directly to the RCA ticket and tag me. we'll track follow-ups there. :v:
